mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_stocktake_reviews(reference,proposal,counted_by) VALUES(#{reference},#{proposal},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_stocktake_reviews SET approved_by=#{actor},approval_reason=#{reason},approved_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE reference=#{reference} AND approved_by IS NULL
UPDATE inventory_stocktake_reviews SET receipt=#{receipt},completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE reference=#{reference} AND approved_by IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
